description: Lets coding agents clone, push to, and open pull requests on the repositories each guild picks in Settings from the platform's GitHub App.
limitations: No model tools: agents use git and gh in their sandbox with a one-hour installation token limited to the guild's repositories. Protecting a default branch is set on GitHub.
setup_hint: Connect at the organisation, a guild, or an agent. The App is installed once per GitHub account; later logins reuse that install. Pick this login's repositories on the GitHub card.
